description: Upper/lower body animation pairs for parallel attacks, referenced from AttackDataTable.Id_ParallelAttack and played alongside the main attack by character-specific action controllers.

Id.simple: Parallel-animation pair key referenced by an Attack row.
Id.technical: FName row key; the export labels it ID. Action controllers read AttackRow->Id_ParallelAttack, skip None, then scan ParallelAttackDataTables with UDataTable::FindRow (inline) or the shared Action_FindParallelAttackRow helper, caching the first match in ParallelAttackRow for stop/finish logic.

CharacterAnimation.simple: Animation name played on the upper body/in parallel with the attack.
CharacterAnimation.technical: FName passed to PlayAnimation(..., -1.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f, true, false) when the parallel attack starts. The pointer is cached in the action's ParallelAttackRow and the same name is passed to StopNamedAnimation(..., 0.0f) when effects finish. CP_240 also compares it literally against "AttackH_01_Order_01" to decide whether auto-aim offset is enabled, so changing the string changes behaviour beyond animation playback.

CharacterAnimation_Lower.simple: Serialized lower-body animation name paired with CharacterAnimation.
CharacterAnimation_Lower.technical: FName serialized in every exported row (for example AttackF_01_OrderL_01 paired with AttackF_01_Order_01). No direct C++ read of this exact property exists in the reconstructed Source/ or Plugins/ tree, including all identified ParallelAttack row readers; its runtime effect is therefore unverified. Do not assume the lower-body name is played by the same consumers that read CharacterAnimation.

notes: AGameDataTableManager::Tick resolves only ParallelAttackDataTable into ParallelAttackDataTables (Source/Abrams/Private/GameDataTableManager.cpp:230, Source/Abrams/Public/GameDataTableManager.h:141).
Identified row readers occur in CP_030, CP_140, CP_160 and CP_240 character action controllers, plus an inline CN_230 reader at Source/Abrams/Private/CN_230_ActionController.cpp:1013.
The exported table has no numbered shards or localization variants. Content is partial, so an asset/Blueprint-only reader of CharacterAnimation_Lower cannot be excluded.
Evidence is reconstructed retail-behaviour source plus serialized export schema; exported names are not treated as behavioural proof.

usages.detail: Resolves AttackRow->Id_ParallelAttack into a cached row and plays CharacterAnimation at homing start.
CP_140 NormalAttack_1 resolves the parallel row via Action_FindParallelAttackRow and plays/stops its upper animation.
CP_160 CursedEnergyAttack_1 starts the row's parallel animation and caches the row.
CP_240 compares CharacterAnimation to a named order animation to enable auto-aim, in addition to play/stop.
CN_230 resolves the row by Attack->Id_ParallelAttack for its own parallel-animation handling.
